childTables._comment: 2026-10-08 live drift: financial/legal/sustainability were removed from asc_consultant entirely and moved into these dedicated 1:1 child tables (asc_financialinformation/asc_legalinformation/asc_sustainabilityesg - placeholder tables added 16 Sept 2026, never wired up until now actually gaining real columns). Same {table, fields} shape as collections below, but exactly one row per consultant, not a list - see saveChildTable()/loadExistingRecordSync() in services.js.

referenceLookupColumns._comment: Fields moved out of the scalar 'fields' maps above because Dataverse now stores them as lookups, not free text. Carried in dataverseMapping's per-row 'references' object (label/local value) for a trusted service to resolve to the GUID column named here - never written directly as a string.

projects.type.note: BLOCKED: asc_ProjectType has no rows yet (placeholder table, only the default field) - cannot resolve labels to IDs until it is built out and seeded. See backend/README.md.

unresolvedLiveGaps._comment: URS/FS-required fields whose Dataverse column no longer exists live. Kept mapped here (not deleted) so requirements aren't silently dropped, per project's no-removal-without-permission rule. Portal writes to these will fail until the columns are restored - do not enable live writes for these fields until resolved.

offices.city.note: Documented in backend/README.md as a deliberate additive FS requirement; removed live, cause unknown.

offices.status.note: Region-eligibility business rule (active office) depends on this. Documented in backend/README.md as a deliberate additive FS requirement; removed live, cause unknown.

offices.leaders.note: Frontend collects up to 3 existing Contact records as leaders (asc_office.asc_leader1_id/2_id/3_id, all removed live). Live now has a single asc_office.asc_officeleaderid lookup to the separate asc_officeleader table (its own name/position/email/phone, not linked to Contact, and singular not up-to-3) - does not match URS §6.3 'up to three senior leaders' or the current frontend. Needs a decision before this can be wired to anything; not mapped to asc_officeleaderid.

bimProjects.lod.note: Required by URS §6.9 'LOD ... Yes'. Removed live with no replacement found.
